description: Climate and Environment water and hydrology sources for the optional water feature: PEGELONLINE stations and raw water levels, USGS Water Data monitoring locations and daily values with approval status, and EEA WISE Water Framework Directive water-body status per reporting cycle. Every source is unverified-live until a dated run (#2647); GRDC is not implemented; no forecasting, gap filling, own status assessments or flood-risk scores.

defaults.update_cadence: hourly re-check of the declared PEGELONLINE windows, daily for USGS daily values and monthly for the WISE reporting cycles; every refresh stays inside the declared selection
defaults.temporal_semantics: observations carry their published timestamp (with offset) or day and a quality state as published; stations and water bodies are revisions by retrieval time; assessments belong to one WFD reporting cycle; every distinct payload is an immutable revision and absence from a later complete USGS window is a dated tombstone

excluded: own water-body status assessments or merged cycles
policy.values: as published, with quality state and qualifiers

sources.scope: Two declared gauging stations on one water (station UUID and number), their gauge zero with validity and published characteristic values, and one bounded window of raw water-level and discharge measurements per declared time series

license.redistribution: permitted without restriction (Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0); attribution kept for citation

water.coverage_decision: two stations, W and Q, one 2-hour window each

selection.label: EXAMPLA on the NORDFLUSS, water level and discharge
NORTHWIND BRÜCKE on the NORDFLUSS, water level

sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs
sources.scope: Two declared monitoring locations and one week of daily mean discharge or gage height each, with approval status and qualifiers per value

license.redistribution: permitted (U.S. public domain); cite USGS; provisional-data disclaimer kept

water.coverage_decision: two monitoring locations, one week of daily values each, at most 100 values per page

sources.publisher: European Environment Agency WISE WFD database
sources.scope: Three declared surface water bodies (EU codes), their published geometry vintage and ecological and chemical status per WFD reporting cycle (2016, 2022) as reported

license.redistribution: permitted with attribution to the EEA and the reporting Member State

water.coverage_decision: three water bodies, two reporting cycles
